about: W6(c) Ask OpsLens routing test. 60 questions a support manager might type (English and Hinglish), each labelled with the tool and the arguments a correct router must produce. Written and committed on 22 Oct 2026 BEFORE either router was run on them. Scoring: 'tool' = the tool matches; 'full' = the tool AND every labelled argument match (whatif: weekday, volume_change_pct, agents_delta; plant: category, effect; explain_ticket: ticket_id). Arguments not labelled are not scored. Caveat: written by Claude 2, who had read both routers' code, so the phrasing is not blind to them.
